findings.resolution: Reject a mismatched response binding as uncertain under the original claimed ID before choosing normalized or legacy persistence. Preserve read-only reconciliation and do not resubmit the effect.

Three Store ordering tests pass: late older callback, applied terminal reconciliation of older turn, and newer continuation retained even after its terminal status is reconciled. Existing source guard checks job sequence/current pointer before provider_context changes.

Receive-only connector retains independent ingress while outbound fails before provider call; voice fixtures separately omit discovery/start, panic on forbidden provider methods, and retain permitted counterpart behavior. All 9 connector-template and 7 voice-flow tests passed.

Current start_with_vapi_media rustdoc explicitly assigns endpoint/account effects to caller-selected adapter and describes polling-disabled loopback fixture use. No claim injection alone prevents external effects.
